description: This file defines the React component 'MultiverseHeading' used for rendering a styled, animated page heading with optional ambient background and particles, specifically designed for various 'hero' pages like Career Multiverse. It includes helper functions for generating particle layouts and manages visual presentation features such as entrance animations, hover effects, and conditional background and particle rendering.

methods.name: Particle
methods.description: A React component rendering an individual decorative particle with optional styling.

methods.name: getCareerMultiverseParticleField
methods.description: Generates deterministic positions, sizes, and animation timings for 12 particles used in the heading.

methods.name: MultiverseHeading
methods.description: Main React component that renders the styled heading with optional ambient background and decorative particles.
